nodes.label: HTTP Diagnostic Inspector fabricated diagnostics
nodes.summary: The drawer in apps/website/src/components/NotFoundApp.tsx:212-237 renders six hardcoded JSX text literals as if they were measured server diagnostics. Verdict CONFIRMED: at least two are provably false for this deployment, one is unimplemented anywhere in the repo, one is unverifiable from the repo.

nodes.label: Evidence Over Claims rule
nodes.summary: The product rule the C7 chunk was opened under: never display a fabricated or unverified fact as if it were measured. Named as the rule the diagnostics drawer violates.

nodes.label: Soft 404 guard claim
nodes.summary: The drawer asserts 'Soft 404 Guard: Enabled (No 200 OK masking)'. A repo-wide rg for soft 404 / soft404 returns only the claim line itself; no guard, config, test, or implementation exists anywhere. IIS and 9110 behave identically: one hit each, both the claim lines.

nodes.label: Astro hybrid output mode
nodes.summary: astro.config.mjs:251 declares output: "static" with the config's own comment that pages with `export const prerender = false` are served as SSR via the Cloudflare adapter. 87 such pages exist, so the deployment is hybrid, but 404.astro has no prerender directive and is prerendered to static HTML.

nodes.label: client:load pre-hydration window
nodes.summary: NotFoundApp is a client:load island. showDiagnostics starts false, so the drawer is absent from the prerendered HTML and the toggle button does nothing until hydration, by which time useEffect has set currentPath. The {currentPath || "N/A"} fallback is therefore effectively unreachable in a hydrated browser, and reachable only in a non-browser render.

nodes.label: No measurement API is ever called by the drawer
nodes.norm_label: no measurement api is ever called by the drawer
nodes.summary: The stated reason the six rows are fabricated rather than measured: exit 1 from `rg -n 'fetch\(|new Response|\.status\b|Response\('` means there is no fetch, no Response object, no status read, no XMLHttpRequest, and no server-injected prop. The only props are locale and strings; the factual rows are JSX text literals compiled into the static bundle and visible in View Source.

nodes.label: Deployment is hybrid, not purely static
nodes.summary: Why the hypothesis's 'there is no SSR' framing was rejected as partly wrong: rg finds 87 pages with prerender = false and adapter: cloudflare(...) at line 259, so SSR does exist in the deployment. Line 221's 'SSR / Static' is not descriptively wrong about the site overall, only about the prerendered page rendering it, and is a string with no measurement behind it either way.

nodes.label: column_definition catch-all arm
nodes.summary: crates/snipset-cli/src/db/init.rs:50, `_ => format!("{column} TEXT")`. Any column the listed arms do not name is created as a bare nullable TEXT, which is how a name can sit on both sides of the fingerprint with a different declared type, NOT NULL flag, and DEFAULT.

nodes.label: Fingerprint name-versus-shape agreement
nodes.summary: GROUP_COLUMNS and SNIPPET_COLUMNS are shared by the desktop app's schema and by `snipset init`'s CREATE TABLE builder, so the two sides agree on column NAMES automatically and by construction. Declared shape is a separate mechanism and nothing about a name alone forces type, NOT NULL, or DEFAULT to agree.

nodes.label: Column declared in both base CREATE TABLE and migration array
nodes.norm_label: column declared in both base create table and migration array
nodes.summary: Commit f7ee4eef1 added research_tag to schema.rs's base CREATE TABLE and to the group_cols array in schema_migrations.rs at the same time. A database created by that release already has the column; an older database gets the same position from ALTER TABLE. Both positions agree, which is why the asserted cid holds on either path.

nodes.label: cid order is not migration array order
nodes.norm_label: cid order is not migration array order
nodes.summary: The general claim that the constants are in migration order is false, with is_favorite as the measured counterexample: it is the ninth entry in the snippet_cols array yet sits at cid 9, because a column present from the start keeps its original cid no matter where the array lists it and the migration's has_col guard skips it.

nodes.label: FROM_CREATE_TABLE hand-maintained subset
nodes.norm_label: from create table hand maintained subset
nodes.summary: The 15-name list guarding `the_fingerprint_declares_no_column_the_app_never_creates` is not a transcription of the base CREATE TABLE. It omits 6 groups base columns and 4 snippets base columns, all of which are in a migration array, and it lists is_favorite even though the migration array also carries it. It is a deliberately incomplete hand-maintained allowlist; completeness against the base schema is not asserted and the forward checks cannot cover it.

nodes.label: Set-based difference() in the fingerprint
nodes.summary: difference() compares sets via contains, never order. Only expected() and current() compare order-sensitively, and those run against the CLI's own init fixture. So a cid-order claim that is false for a migrated database is currently harmless and becomes wrong the moment anyone asserts order on snippets.

nodes.label: Concurrent rebase discarded working-tree edits
nodes.norm_label: concurrent rebase discarded working tree edits
nodes.summary: A rebase mid-task by the parent session reset the worktree: HEAD hashes changed (2ff5df447 -> 78c990c89), earlier commits reappeared as 2030dbccc and 824a83e7b, and the chunk's uncommitted edits were discarded. The four corrections in the final report are the re-applied, re-verified set, not the first round.

nodes.label: Names agree automatically; shapes come from column_definition
nodes.norm_label: names agree automatically shapes come from column definition
nodes.summary: The stated reason the 'the two stay consistent automatically' doc claim was false beyond column NAMES: `snipset init` maps every name through column_definition, whose catch-all emits TEXT for any unlisted column, so a name can be present on both sides while type, NOT NULL, and DEFAULT all differ. Measured: research_tag is INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 in the app and TEXT with no default in init.

nodes.label: cid 11 holds on either path, from agreement of two sources
nodes.norm_label: cid 11 holds on either path from agreement of two sources
nodes.summary: The verified reason the position assertion passes: a database created by the release already has research_tag at cid 11 straight after is_deleted, and an older database reaches the same cid 11 from ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, which appends. So the position holds either way, but the reason is the agreement of the two sources, not the migration alone.

nodes.label: The subset list still passes because every omission is migrated
nodes.norm_label: subset list still passes because every omission is migrated
nodes.summary: Why an incomplete FROM_CREATE_TABLE list is not a defect in the check: all 10 omitted base columns are in a migration array, so the assertion still passes. The prose was wrong about what the list was, not about what it does, which is why the comment was reworded rather than the list expanded.

nodes.label: Rebase cost an editing round
nodes.summary: A rebase mid-task reset the working tree and discarded an earlier round of edits; the four edits reported are the re-applied, re-verified set. Recorded as a process note in the deliverable so the parent knows the diff was produced twice.
